# Windows (x86_64) "engines" venv -- the mirror of requirements_engines_mac.txt
# for the Windows kit. Same pinned versions; the ONLY difference is torch:
#
# torch/torchaudio are NOT listed here. On Windows, plain PyPI torch is the
# CPU-only wheel, so the CUDA build is installed separately from the pytorch.org
# cu128 index by installSpec.js (buildSteps: torchCuda) BEFORE this file. That
# keeps GPU acceleration while letting these packages resolve normally.

# Local Whisper transcription (app/scripts/whisper_transcribe.py).

# The laughter/breath whitelist (app/nonverbal.py) shells out to the ORIGINAL
# openai-whisper (~140MB "base", fetched on first use).
openai-whisper
